annotations.title: All plan prices in one region

description: Show every plan price of one product in one country or region, for each sales channel and billing interval, with its rank among all regions and its difference from the United States. Answers questions like "how much does ChatGPT cost in Japan?" or "is Claude cheaper in India than in the US?".

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for converted reference prices, e.g. USD, CNY, EUR. Defaults to USD for en and CNY for zh.

locale.description: Language for region and plan names: en (default) or zh.

product.description: Product key returned by list_catalog, including dynamically registered app_<apple-id> products.

region.description: Country or region as an ISO 3166 code (JP), English name (Japan) or Chinese name (日本).

name: get_region_prices

localAmount.description: Reference price in the local currency for the billing interval; App Store yearly amounts are full-year totals.

referencePrice.description: Monthly-equivalent reference price converted to the requested currency.

vsUs.description: Percent difference from the United States reference price.

yearlyTotal.description: Full-year reference amount in the requested currency (yearly billing only).

title: All plan prices in one region
